title: Docker Agent read_skill Missing Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Docker Agent. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
The specific flaw exists within the read_skill tool. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.
addtionnal_details:
Docker has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://github.com/docker/docker-agent/security/advisories/GHSA-8f6v-26r8-3r4h
